answer: Witness weight is spent per pair: three endorsements of one author exhaust a validator's say. A farm cannot cycle a few vouchers around its own accounts, because each epoch every fake author needs validators it has never met, and those validators must already hold graded verdicts. A freshly minted batch is worth nothing: nobody with standing may sign it yet. Picture a garden where a vine wraps one stake once, then needs an unvisited jade post to climb; growth follows posts actually earned. A sybil ring pays calendar time plus independent grading labour per identity; capital shortens neither.
